implementation_rule: Do these preflight/architecture stories before proceeding with new OMP-specific core features; preserve already completed FAB-* stories

stories.title: Audit and isolate shared core from OMP assumptions
stories.objective: Inventory vendor-specific assumptions, introduce HarnessId/versioned adapter registry, preserve existing OMP behavior.

stories.title: Version-specific harness probe and capability plan
stories.objective: Declare support/limitations with typed failure before scheduling; no unavailable features silently downgraded.

stories.title: Two fake adapters and mixed-harness batch
stories.objective: Exercise different launch/event schemas in one batch through the same run lifecycle.

stories.title: Native profile and credential boundaries
stories.objective: Per-adapter config discovery and secret-safe launch; no arbitrary env/Home propagation to remote.

stories.title: Second real harness adapter
stories.objective: Implement Codex or Qwen adapter and opt-in smoke test without default CI model calls.

stories.title: Control surface neutrality and pstack compatibility
stories.objective: OMP extension and CLI share one run API; mixed-harness pstack scenario without harness-specific scripts.
